subject: english
prompt: A calendar says a festival begins on the first day of a lunar month. What information does this give?

options.text: It says the moon is a building.
It gives the festival's date according to a lunar calendar.
It proves the festival lasts one year.
It tells us the festival has no date.

answer.explanation: The statement identifies the calendar system used to set the date.
